$comment: Worked cases for state_sha256. The definition is the header of tools/lib/export-state.mjs in astra-registry; every implementation must reproduce `lines` and `state_sha256` from `files` (path to base64 bytes) for each case. bot/tests/export-state.test.mjs holds the registry's implementation to them.

cases.name: empty
cases.note: No file under plugins/ or log/: SHA-256 of the empty string.

cases.name: one-listing
cases.note: log/ sorts before plugins/; each line ends in a line feed, the last one too.

cases.name: bytes-as-stored
cases.note: Content is hashed as stored: an empty file, CRLF line ends, no trailing newline, and non-UTF-8 bytes are all kept exactly.

cases.name: byte-order
cases.note: Paths compare by their UTF-8 bytes: '-' (2d) < '.' (2e) < '/' (2f) < 'A' (41) < 'a' (61); U+FF21 (EF BC A1) sorts before U+1F600 (F0 9F 98 80). A UTF-16 sort, such as JavaScript's default sort(), puts U+1F600 first and gives `not_this_utf16_order_gives`.
